meta.title: Another user from the same vendor company cannot bid twice
gaps: Sign in as the second user from the same vendor company and attempt a second bid without revising the existing bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the second user from the same vendor company and attempt a second bid without revising the existing bid.

plan.title: Same Vendor Company Cannot Bid Twice

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event creation flow.
A title is mandatory for a publishable event.
Create an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor bid.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one item for the bid.
Complete the pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite one QA vendor company to the RFQ.
Confirm the event is live and usable.
Have the first user from the invited vendor company submit the initial bid.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.

args.need: sign in as the second user from the same vendor company and try to submit a second bid without revising the existing bid

steps.note: A second user identity from the same vendor company is required to test the company-level duplicate-bid refusal.
Verify the buyer still sees exactly one vendor response after the second-user attempt.
